context: In this paper, we have constructed AUSO on which the three pivot rules of interest can take exponentially long paths. Several interesting problems remain open: First and foremost is settling if Zadeh’s and Johnson’s rules admit exponential lower bounds even on linear programs. Moreover, it remains open to decide if Zadeh’s rule admits Hamiltonian paths on AUSO, a direction suggested by the authors of [1]. Finally, we are interested in exponential lower bounds for all the history-based rules that are discussed in [1]. We believe that our methods can be used to prove exponential lower bounds on AUSO for all of those rules.
